discovered_after: Run 35340799374; sub-1983 failed in channel-name binding while other subject jobs had already completed, but no successful subject kappa/secondary values or aggregate outcome were inspected
observed_failure: For sub-1983 MNE exposed the ordered generic labels EEG001..EEG060,EOG061,EOG062,ECG063,EEG064. The frozen adapter recognized only the narrower all-EEG pattern EEG001..EEG064, so it did not apply the already frozen positional BIDS channels.tsv binding.

correction.rule: Treat a decoded channel list as generic positional labels when every name consists of letters followed by a three-digit ordinal equal to its 1-based channel position. Only then bind positionally to the already frozen BIDS channels.tsv names before selecting the unchanged preregistered 19 sensors.

safeguards: The ordinal sequence must be exact 001..N; arbitrary or semantic channel labels are never positionally remapped.
The number of BIDS channel rows must equal the number of decoded channels.
The frozen channels.tsv Git blob identity must match before any renaming.
No successful subject kappa or secondary metric value was inspected to determine this correction.
invariants: No source EEG bytes, BIDS metadata bytes, channel order or preregistered channel mapping are changed.
No preregistered sensor, window, hierarchy, endpoint, hypothesis, cohort, exclusion, statistical test or alpha is changed.
No aggregate group result existed when this correction was frozen.
